priorityList: Maintain Blade Flurry, preferably using it at low Combo Points to benefit from Deft Maneuvers.
If talented, use Keep It Rolling when you have 4+ buffs active. If missing Broadside, wait until the last second of your lowest duration buff to use it.
Use Adrenaline Rush on cooldown at low Combo Points.
Use Blade Rush on cooldown as a builder.
Cast Between the Eyes on cooldown with 6+ Combo Points.
Cast Dispatch as your main finisher at 5+ Combo Points.
Cast Pistol Shot if you have 6 stacks of Opportunity, or at 1-3 Combo Points if you have 3 stacks.
Cast Sinister Strike to generate Combo Points.
Maintain Blade Flurry at all times to enable AoE cleave.
Use Roll the Bones if no buffs are active or to refresh expiring buffs.
Cast Between the Eyes at maximum Combo Points while in Stealth, Vanish, or Shadow Dance (Crackshot).
Cast Blade Rush on cooldown to generate Energy and deal AoE damage.
Cast Dispatch at maximum Combo Points if Between the Eyes is on cooldown or Crackshot is not active.
Cast Pistol Shot with Opportunity procs if you are not at maximum Combo Points.
Cast Sinister Strike as your primary generator to build Combo Points.
